```{r}
# Filtering out data that does not include launch speed and launch angle
batted_ball_data <- xBA_baseball_data |>
  filter(!is.na(launch_speed) & !is.na(launch_angle))

# Creating a heatmap for launch angle versus launch speed, colored based off proportion of base hits per unit of area
batted_ball_heatmap <- ggplot(batted_ball_data, aes(x = launch_speed, y = launch_angle, z = as.numeric(is_hit))) +
  # Sizing each unit of area to be 2mph of launch speed by 5 degrees of launch angle
  stat_summary_2d(fun = mean, binwidth = c(2, 5)) +
  scale_fill_gradientn(
    colors = c("lightyellow", "orange", "red"),
    name = "Base Hit Rate"
  ) + 
  # Adjusting coordinates to exclude outlier values
  coord_cartesian(xlim = c(50, 120), ylim = c(-40, 60)) +
  labs(
    title = "Base Hit Rate by Exit Velocity and Launch Angle",
    x = "Exit Velocity (mph)",
    y = "Launch Angle (Degrees)"
  ) +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank() # Removes minor gridlines for a cleaner look
  )
batted_ball_heatmap
```

```{r}
# Computing generalized linear regression statistics on batting average versus year
batted_ball_model <- glm(as.numeric(is_hit) ~ launch_speed + launch_angle + I(launch_angle^2), 
                 data = batted_ball_data, 
                 family = "binomial")
summary(batted_ball_model)
```
